news.title: Iran continues to hit Gulf countries as Israeli strikes intensify; Tehran says new leader appointed
news.description: Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates report more strikes on civilian targets as U.S.-Israeli attacks on Iran continue.

news.title: Energy prices will fall when U.S. destroys Iran's ability to attack tankers in Strait of Hormuz: Wright
news.description: Gas prices have spiked in the U.S. as oil has jumped to over $90 since the war began in Iran.

news.title: Investors may be too complacent about mounting risks with the S&P 500 less than 4% from high
news.description: The year so far has been marred with geopolitical volatility, leading some to believe the market may not be as concerned as it should be about war in Iran.
